title: Orv and Pat Johnson buy it
bodyMd:
In 1981 Orv and Pat Johnson bought the bar. They ran it as a family place for forty-four years.

That is the stretch most people in Eau Claire remember: the burgers ground behind the bar, the root beer in the iced mug, the same faces on the same stools.

It is also the stretch in which the bar's history got told out loud. Orv is the one who put the oldest-bar claim into words, carefully, and it is his words we use.
